title: 从 arr[1] 初始化：n=1 越界且首元素被跳过
behavior_notes: 两个表现：$n$=1 时 `arr[1]` 是越界访问（违反 $n>=1$ 约定下的下标范围）；$n>=2$ 时循环从 $i$=2 开始，`arr[0]` 从未参与比较，最大值在首位时结果错误（如 `[5,3,2]` 返回 3）。
input_coverage: 最大值在中/末位（结果碰巧正确）

diagnosis.summary: 初值取 `arr[1]` 且循环从 $i$=2 开始：一方面 $n$=1 时 `arr[1]` 越界访问；另一方面 `arr[0]` 在任何输入下都未参与比较，最大值位于首位时结果错误。两个表现源于同一处初始化选择。

issues.description: $n$=1 时合法下标只有 0，int $max$ = `arr[1]` 是越界访问（未定义行为）
issues.description_en: max is initialized from `arr[1]`, which is out of bounds when n = 1, and `arr[0]` is never examined.

issues.description: 初值取 `arr[1]` 且循环从 $i$=2 开始，`arr[0]` 从未参与比较；最大值在首位时返回错误结果

diagnosis.summary_en: max is initialized from `arr[1]`, which is already out of bounds when n = 1, and `arr[0]` is never examined. The questionnaire probes initialization validity and coverage.

questions.question: 在题目约定 $n >= 1$ 下，调用 `find_max(arr, 1)` 时你的程序会发生什么？
choices: 执行 int $max$ = `arr[1]`，访问了不存在的下标，属于越界未定义行为
循环不执行，程序什么也不做也没有副作用
questions.question_en: Under the assignment guarantee $n >= 1$, what happens when your program is called as `find_max(arr, 1)`?
choices_en: It evaluates int $max$ = `arr[1]`, accessing a nonexistent index — out-of-bounds undefined behavior
The loop never runs; the program does nothing and has no side effects

questions.question: 输入 `[5, 3, 2]`（$n$ = 3）时，程序返回什么？真正的最大值是多少？
choices: 返回 3；真正的最大值是 5，它从未参与比较
questions.question_en: For the input `[5, 3, 2]` (n = 3), what does the program return, and what is the true maximum?
choices_en: Returns 3; the true maximum 5 never takes part in any comparison
Returns 2; the comparison direction is reversed
The result is undefined and unpredictable

questions.question: 从概念上说，最大值的初始值应当满足什么条件？
choices: 是数组中确实存在的候选，并且其下标在任何满足约定的合法输入下都可访问
数值上越小越好，哪怕是数组之外的数
questions.question_en: Conceptually, what condition must the initial candidate for a maximum satisfy?
choices_en: It is a candidate that exists in the array, and its index is accessible for every legal input satisfying the guarantee
Numerically as small as possible, even a value outside the array

questions.question: 对 `[9, 4, 7]`，你的函数返回什么？请具体说明 9 为什么没有被找到。
questions.expected_answer: 返回 7。max 初值取 arr[1]=4，循环从 i=2 开始只检查了 arr[2]=7；arr[0]=9 从未被读取或比较，因此不可能被发现。
